description: Steer secrets through 1Password: block secrets pasted in chat (erased before Claude sees them), block commands/reads/writes that would leak or hard-code a secret, and stop Claude from asking the user to paste a secret. python3 or python must be on PATH; otherwise the hooks fail open.

hooks.command: sh -c 'p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" prompt'
sh -c 'p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" bash'
sh -c 'p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" write'
sh -c 'p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" read'
sh -c 'p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" stop'
